items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Peggy Lee? Dave Barbour? They were on that recording -- session? ... [INTERVIEWEE] I think Dave Barbour -- was on the session, in that band with Lena Horne.

ctx.x: She came in and did a good job, and I could confine my activities to the conductor of the band (inaudible) recorded, so that was great, and old Syd was out of sight. So -- let's see -- if I remember correctly, Syd made a few dates on the road, but not many. He was another like Benny Martin. He didn't dig the road too much.
He wanted to stay home. Yeah. What about Peggy Lee? Dave Barbour? They were on that recording --
